summary: The Government of Jamaica filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a U.S.$1,000,000,000 offering of 6.250% Notes due 2037, issued under its existing shelf (File No. 333-297915). The notes price at 100.000% of par, with a 0.170% underwriting discount, yielding U.S.$998,300,000 in proceeds before expenses; settlement is expected on or about September 17, 2026. Principal amortizes in three equal installments beginning September 17, 2035, with semi-annual interest from March 17, 2027. Citigroup is global coordinator, with Scotiabank as joint lead manager and bookrunner. This is a routine sovereign debt takedown, not a special situation.
